passages.excerpt_preview: He described using mechanical, thermal, chemical and electrical stimuli, and compared recorded response curves.

passages.excerpt_preview: n Response in the Living and Non-Living, Bose presented experiments on electrical response in metals and living tissues.

passages.locator: distinctions between living and non-living matter
passages.excerpt_preview: Bose argued that response could be investigated through sensitive instruments and that apparent distinctions between living and non-living matter might be less absolute than contemporary accounts allowed.
